description: Hydrogen Fueling Network Site Status is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Caltrans. This dataset supports a ArcGIS Dashboard created for the Statewide Hydrogen Fueling Infrastructure Framework and a Zero-Emission Technology Adoption Toolkit Project, overseen by Caltrans. The dashboard is linked at this URL. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher Caltrans. Its tags are CAOpenData, CalSTA, California, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency. It offers 7 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
